in_marathi.name: Rishiven
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Senses
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rishiven हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit words 'Rishi' (sage) and 'Ven' (lotus), Rishiven signifies a person with a sage-like control over their senses.

vedic_reference.note: This name is not directly found in Vedic texts, but it combines two Sanskrit words: ऋषि (Rishi), meaning 'sage' or 'seer', and वेन् (Vena), meaning 'arrow' or 'path'. Together, it implies a spiritually evolved person who is perceptive and knows the path to wisdom.
